answer: Fail first on idle identity: decay reputation every epoch it does not ship, so a parked account loses standing before it can be rented out. Next, reset the bond on any identity-link attempt, since shared funding is the cheapest tell an operator leaves. Then measure trust per task, not per address, because a forged history is expensive while a fresh address is free. A garden of dormant clones therefore costs upkeep and earns nothing, and no harbor of saved-up standing survives a month of silence. Attack cost is the decay rate times the wait.
